title: Hello LinkedIn!
summary: Natalie Karolak explains her decision to join LinkedIn after years of refusing to do so, motivated by Microsoft's focus on LinkedIn as its primary social network and the large Business Central community there. She plans to promote blog posts and share summaries while keeping Bluesky as her primary platform.
key_points: Microsoft's commitment to LinkedIn as its main social network prompted the author to join to avoid missing Business Central community news.
The author will use LinkedIn to promote blog posts and share weekly or monthly summaries of Bluesky posts on BC documentation and AL programming.
Bluesky remains the author's primary social media platform for frequent sharing and community engagement.
The author explicitly discourages headhunter contact and prioritizes direct feedback on communication from the community.
